violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --In-use utensil was not properly stored during pauses in food preparation or dispensing. Scoops in nut containers was stored handle down. Scoops need to be stored handle up.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Wire rack in pizza hold had rust and plastic cracking. Cutting boards observe to have deep cuts and need to be resurfaced.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Drainboard/rack/tablespace was insufficient to accommodate equipment/utensils. Observed oversized drainboard that was rusted and had plastic cracking on wire..

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Walls surrounding pizza station need cleaning more frequent.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Observed rust and peeling coating on rack used for drying dishes
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Observed buildup of debris inside of cold hold units.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.
